column1: # One entry per line:  REPO_PATH <TAB> SOURCE_PATH
#   REPO_PATH    relative to the repo root
#   SOURCE_PATH  the live location on this machine (~ is expanded)
# A trailing slash on both sides means "directory" (synced with --delete).
# Lines starting with # are comments. Nothing outside this file is synced.
# Per-entry excludes: append  <TAB> ex:GLOB[,GLOB...]  as a third field.
# NOTE: only config.yml. hosts.yml holds OAuth tokens and is never synced.
# Allowlist only: global CLAUDE.md, settings, hooks and skills (custom and third-party).
# Nothing managed via claude.ai: skills/synced/ holds org-provisioned skills,
# skills/.trash/ holds removed ones. Commands are not tracked.
